summary: Frontend-only UI verification of two Admin Approvals additions: (1) Lead Source badge and (2) Applicant Message dialog. Logged in via real /login form as admin.qa@islandhop-demo.com (httpOnly cookie), navigated /admin -> Approvals tab -> Driver Applications sub-tab -> status filter 'All'. Both features work as specified. Send button was intentionally NOT clicked (live email/SMS).

issues: No SMS character counter/length warning; the inserted 'request documents' template is a long multi-line email-style body (bullets, ~350+ chars) that will be split into several SMS segments when sent as Text. Consider a shorter SMS variant of the template.

action_items: Optional: provide a shorter SMS-specific 'request documents' template / add character count in the Text channel (cost + multi-segment SMS).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminApprovals.js search input only filters on Enter/refresh click (no debounce). Typing a query leaves the list unchanged, which can look broken to admins - pre-existing behavior, not part of this change.
seed_data_creation: None created; used existing seeded lead msg_lead_f7351976 ('Message Test Lead').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified details: source badge data-testid=record-source-msg_lead_f7351976 renders text 'islandhoptt.com' with external-link icon and title 'Applied via islandhoptt.com'. Note the lead only appears under the 'Driver Applications' sub-tab with status filter 'All' (default filter for drivers hides it since status=pending shows under 'New'? it appeared only after clicking approvals-status-all). Message dialog (applicant-message-dialog): Email is the default channel -> shows To: msg_test_lead@example.com, message-subject-input visible, message-body-input textarea, Send button labeled 'Send email'. Clicking message-docs-template-btn fills subject 'Your IslandHop application' and a body listing required documents (ID, driver's licence, vehicle registration & insurance). Switching to message-channel-sms removes the subject input entirely (count=0), 'To:' becomes +18685551234, Send label becomes 'Send text', body text is preserved across channel switch. Escape closes the dialog. No console errors during the flow. message-send-btn was NEVER clicked (live email/SMS).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no defects found in the tested features.
